name: Shepherd's Purse
caution: A safe common mustard; eat the young leaves before the plant turns tough and bitter. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Named for its distinctive little heart- or purse-shaped seed pods marching up the stem. The basal leaves resemble a small dandelion.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Young leaves are a peppery green raw or lightly cooked; the plant is a prized potherb across the world.
